4121 pleonazo {pleh-on-ad'-zo}

from 4119; TDNT - 6:263,864; v

AV - abound 6, abundant 1, have over 1, make to increase 1; 9

1) to superabound
   1a) of things
       1a1) to exist in abundance
       1a2) to increase
       1a3) be augmented
2) to make to increase: one in a thing
